annotations.title: MISIM.AI — Israeli Primary Legislation Search · חיפוש בחקיקה הראשית

description: Search the text of primary Israeli tax and business LEGISLATION — the statutes themselves: the Income Tax Ordinance (פקודת מס הכנסה), the VAT Law, the National Insurance Law, the Companies Law, the Securities Law, the Real Estate Taxation Law, the Encouragement of Capital Investments Law, the Customs Ordinance, Purchase Tax, Property Tax and the depreciation regulations. Returns the actual section text with its number, title and a citation link to the Knesset national legislation database. Look up a specific section with `law` + `section` (e.g. law "פקודת מס הכנסה", section "102"), or search the statute text with `query`. At least one of query, law or section is required. Long sections are returned truncated and say so (has_more); continue a section lookup with offset = next_offset, or follow the citation for the complete text — never complete it from memory. Use this when the question turns on what the LAW says. חיפוש בחקיקה הראשית.

law.description: Restrict to one law. Accepts the Hebrew name ("חוק מס ערך מוסף") or the internal key ("VAT"). Use misim_list_laws for the list.

limit.description: Max sections to return (default 5). Sections are long — keep this small.

offset.description: Section lookup only (requires `section`): character offset into the section text to continue reading from (default 0). Pass next_offset from the previous call; each call returns up to 3000 characters.

query.description: Free text searched in the section title and body, in Hebrew. Each word must appear; connectives are dropped.

section.description: Exact section number, e.g. "102" or "3(ט)". Combine with `law` for a direct lookup.
